hero.title: Convert media. Keep it yours.
hero.subtitle: Images and audio are converted in your browser. Video can stay on your device or use this server. Every file can hit a target size.

footer.local: Images and audio stay on your device.

upload.title: Drop files here
upload.subtitle: Images, audio and video. Click to browse.
upload.privacy: Images and audio never leave your browser.
upload.unsupported: {name} is not a supported media file.
upload.tooMany: You can add up to {count} files.

file.targetHelp: Fit the output at or below this size.
file.serverHint: Uploads the file to this instance and converts it with ffmpeg. The file is erased after the job expires.
file.localHint: Runs in your browser with WebAssembly. Nothing is uploaded.
file.localVideoWarn: Local video downloads a ~31 MB engine and is slower. Keep this tab open.
file.canceledHint: The conversion was cancelled; retry when ready.

target.title: Review target size
target.imageNote: Quality and dimensions are adjusted automatically to fit {size}.
target.audioNote: The bitrate is calculated from the duration to fit {size}.
target.videoNote: Two-pass encoding keeps the output at or below the target.
target.localVideoNote: Two-pass encoding runs in your browser. Keep this tab open.
target.warnLarger: The target is larger than the source; the extra room may not improve quality.
target.warnHigh: This target requires a very high bitrate.
target.warnAboveMax: The requested size exceeds the codec maximum; the bitrate was capped.
target.warnRetried: The first pass overshot; a second pass with a lower bitrate was used.

settings.title: Preferences
settings.description: Defaults for new files. Stored only in this browser.
settings.autoDownloadHint: Save each finished file as soon as it is ready.
settings.serverUnavailable: Server conversion is unavailable; video will use the on-device engine.
settings.aboutText: FireConverter is a local-first media converter. Images and audio stay in your browser; video can stay local or use this server. No account and no tracking.
settings.storage: Preferences live in localStorage on this device.

privacy.imageBody: Resized and re-encoded with Canvas. Nothing is uploaded.
privacy.audioBody: Converted with ffmpeg.wasm on your device.
privacy.videoBody: Convert locally or upload to this server; server files expire automatically.

errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.too_large: The file exceeds the server size limit.
errors.too_long: The file is longer than the server allows.
errors.image_local: Images are converted in the browser.
errors.no_video: The file has no video track.
errors.no_audio: The file has no audio track.
errors.probe_failed: The file could not be inspected.
errors.target_too_small: The target size is too small for this file.
errors.target_missed: The output could not fit the target size. Try a larger target.
errors.target_unsupported: Target size is not available for this output.
errors.targetUnsupported: Target size is not available for this output.
errors.target_too_large: The target size exceeds the server limit.
errors.ffmpeg_missing: Server conversion is unavailable on this instance.
errors.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_state: The job changed state; try again.
errors.duration_unknown: The duration could not be read.
errors.not_found: The job expired or was removed.
errors.engine: The local conversion engine failed to start.
errors.validation: Check the settings and try again.
errors.avifUnsupported: This browser cannot encode AVIF; WebP was selected.
errors.targetRange: The target must be at least {min} MB.
errors.targetTooLarge: The target must be at most {max} MB.
errors.fpsInvalid: The frame rate must be between 1 and 240.
errors.clearWhileBusy: Wait for active conversions before clearing the queue.
errors.serverUnreachable: The API could not be reached
errors.serverUnreachableHint: Local conversion still works. Server video stays unavailable until the backend is reachable.
